# Filter out rows that are not actual seasons (like "Totals:" and "No Team" and "Upcoming")
df_filtered = df[~df['Season'].astype(str).str.contains('Totals|No Team|Upcoming', na=False)]

# Convert 'Season' to numeric, errors='coerce' will turn non-numeric to NaN
df_filtered['Season'] = pd.to_numeric(df_filtered['Season'], errors='coerce')

# Drop rows where 'Season' became NaN (just in case)
df_filtered = df_filtered.dropna(subset=['Season'])

# Convert 'Total Wins' to numeric, coerce errors to NaN
df_filtered['Total Wins'] = pd.to_numeric(df_filtered['Total Wins'], errors='coerce')

# Find the row with the maximum 'Total Wins'
max_wins_row = df_filtered.loc[df_filtered['Total Wins'].idxmax()]

# Get the season (year) from that row
answer = int(max_wins_row['Season'])
